info.title: DienstPilot API
info.description: Demo environment, synthetic data. Fictional Klinik für Innere Medizin, Klinikum Musterstadt.

get.description: Liveness: the API process is running.
Readiness: Postgres (with pgvector) and Redis are reachable. 503 if any check fails.
List the demo personas (UI_SPEC §1).

post.description: Sign in as a demo persona. Real single sign-on replaces this later.

get.description: Return the signed-in user.
Return the demo clock (the UI uses it for "today" and countdowns).
M2: the next shift with colleagues, the open request window, open cover requests.
M3: the physician's month with wish marks (granted, missed).
M4: the open request window, the person's entries and preference suggestions.

put.description: M4: replace the person's answer to the open window (no approval needed, PROCESS §2).

post.description: M4: interpret free text ("Wir haben verstanden: …"). The text is not stored.

get.description: M5: the person's leave requests.

schema.title: Response My Leave Me Leave Get

post.description:
M5: request leave ("Ohne Tausch" or "Mit Tausch beantragen"); the Planner decides.

With a trade, the check must have offered one for exactly these dates; the extra weekend
becomes a binding constraint when the earlier month is planned, once the Planner approves.
M5: instant hint (C6), and a background C1 check of coverability and trade-off.

get.description: M5: the background check: coverable, coverable with a trade-off, or not coverable.
M6: swaps the person offered or took.

schema.title: Response My Swaps Me Swaps Get

post.description: M6: offer an own future shift to eligible colleagues.

get.description: M6: how many colleagues could take this shift without breaking a rule (C2).
M6: open offers of colleagues the person could take without breaking a rule (C2).

schema.title: Response Open Offers Me Swap Offers Get

post.description:
M6: take a colleague's offer, alone or in exchange for one of your own shifts.

C2 checks both people with every change applied. A valid swap is approved by the Planner's
policy (logged as policy-approved); a swap with a new violation, or with the policy off,
goes to the Planner.
M7: report sick (no approval, PROCESS §2); cover searches start for each affected shift.

get.description: M8: open cover requests with countdown and hours impact.

schema.title: Response Cover Requests Me Cover Requests Get

post.description:
M8: take the shift ("Übernehmen") or decline.

A valid cover within the contract hours is approved by the policy; otherwise the Planner
decides (W7b).

get.description: M9: own nights, weekends and holidays against the department (anonymous statistics).
M10: own hours for a month (default: the current month).
M11: roster published or changed, swap updates, leave decisions, cover requests.
M12: personal settings (every signed-in user).

put.description: M12: change personal settings. Oversight is read-only and cannot change anything.

get.description:
W4 grid and the full roster for Staff+: shifts, absences, leave, coverage per shift.

With ``variant_id`` (Planner only) the grid shows a draft variant of a C1 run.
Colleagues who could take a published shift, validated by C2 and ordered by C5.

post.description:
Check changes to published rosters with C2 without writing anything (a what-if).

The same checks as a real change (W4): future days only, a published month, department staff.

patch.description: W4: change a draft (live validation) or a published roster (reason, C2-valid, notify).

post.description: W4: live validation with C2 (all rules, the whole month).

get.description: W3: every run of a month (the seeded manual roster and C1 runs), newest first.

post.description: W3: queue a C1 run for a month that is not published yet; the worker solves it.

get.description: W3: a run's progress, its variants with metrics, or why no valid roster exists.

post.description: W5: approve and publish a draft. It must pass the validator (C2) without a violation.

get.description: W11: the auto-approval policy.
W1: window progress, escalations, coverage of the next 14 days with expected absences.
W2: who has answered the window.

post.description: W2: "Erinnerung senden" to everyone who has not answered (push comes later).
W2: close the window.

get.description: W6: pending leave with computed impact, escalated swaps and cover, open proposals.

post.description: W6: "Genehmigen" or "Ablehnen mit Begründung".
W6: approve or decline an escalated swap. An approval must pass the validator (C2).
W6: mark a proposal accepted or dismissed. Acting on it is a separate, validated change.

get.description: W7: open and escalated cover searches, and those closed in the last 7 days.

schema.title: Response Live Cascades Planner Cascades Get

get.description: W7b: options to close the gap, ranked, with hours and overtime consequences.

post.description: W7b: close a cover search the way the Planner chose.

get.description: W8 (Planner) and W12 (Oversight, without names).
Per-person hours, overtime and rest compliance (C2) of a month (Planner and Oversight).
W8: department overtime per month for the last published months.

schema.title: Response Overtime Trend Compliance Overtime Trend Get

post.description: W9: ask the copilot (stand-in). It reads; it cannot publish or approve anything.
W9: create a proposal. It changes nothing until the Planner acts on it.

get.description:
W10: the audit trail, filterable.

Same privacy rules as everywhere: no absence category for anyone but the Planner.

post.description: W10: verify the whole hash chain now (Planner or Oversight) and return the result.

get.description: W11: master data and versioned rules (Administrator and Planner).

post.description: W11: add a rule version ("Neue Regelversion ab 01.01.2027"). Old rosters keep theirs.

get.description: W12: hours and overtime per person, fairness as anonymous statistics, audit export.
W12: export of the audit trail (same privacy rules), up to 5 000 events.

W13: what each component is, how far it is built, and that none can change the roster.

C1 to C8, then the rulebook retrieval (RAG), which has no component number.
Months whose documentation has been prepared, newest first.
Return the month-end report: hours, overtime, rest, burden and the decision trail.

post.description: Confirm the prepared documentation with one click: locks the month, releases payroll.

get.description: Return the payroll export of a closed month (409 until the Planner has closed it).
Search the rulebook (German and English questions). Every passage carries its citation.
Return one passage by its id, for example ``arbzg:§5:1``.

put.description:
Move the demo clock (Administrator, DEMO_MODE only). Stored in Redis.

Moving it forward fires every timer that has become due, in order, before the call returns
(ADR-017); moving it back un-fires nothing.

AskOut.title: AskOut
AskOut.description: The copilot's answer with figures and cited rules.

AssignmentChange.title: AssignmentChange
AssignmentChange.description: One suggested change to a published roster, as in W4: reassign, remove or add a shift.

variant_id.title: Variant Id
variant_id.description: A draft variant; omit for the published roster

AssignmentEdit.title: AssignmentEdit
AssignmentEdit.description:
W4: one change. A draft changes directly; a published roster needs a reason.

``assignment_id`` with ``new_staff_id`` reassigns (``null`` removes the shift); ``add``
adds a shift. A change to a published roster must not break any rule (C2), and everyone
affected is notified.

AuditEventOut.title: AuditEventOut
AuditEventOut.description: An audit event as the viewer may see it.

AuditPage.title: AuditPage
AuditPage.description: W10: a page of the audit trail.

CascadeDecision.title: CascadeDecision
CascadeDecision.description: The Planner's choice for a gap.

CascadeOut.title: CascadeOut
CascadeOut.description: W7: a cover search as a timeline.

absence.title: Absence
absence.description: status 'absent'; the category only for the Planner

Cell.title: Cell
Cell.description: What a physician has on a day.

newer_events.title: Newer Events
newer_events.description: Entries appended since the check; each links up

ChainOut.title: ChainOut
ChainOut.description: What the log may claim about itself: the result of the last real verification.

ClockIn.title: ClockIn
ClockIn.description: A new demo time, or reset to the default demo moment.

Colleague.title: Colleague
Colleague.description: A colleague on the same shift (no other detail).

eval_metric.title: Eval Metric
eval_metric.description: Written by an eval/ script (eval/results/c1.json …); None until then

CoverCandidates.title: CoverCandidates
CoverCandidates.description: Who could take a shift, C2-checked and in C5's order (staff ids; names are for the UI).

CoverRequestOut.title: CoverRequestOut
CoverRequestOut.description: M8: an open cover request to the person.

CoverTask.title: CoverTask
CoverTask.description: An open cover request to the person.

short.title: Short
short.description: Demand rows with fewer physicians than required

CoverageDay.title: CoverageDay
CoverageDay.description: Coverage and expected absences of one day.

CoverageRow.title: CoverageRow
CoverageRow.description: Demand against assigned physicians for one day, shift and qualification.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: Approve or decline. A decline needs the Planner's reason (shown to the requester).

DemandOut.title: DemandOut
DemandOut.description: The demand rows of one example day.

DistributionOut.title: DistributionOut
DistributionOut.description: Anonymous department statistics of one metric (nights, weekends, holidays).

EditOut.title: EditOut
EditOut.description: What the change did, and the violations of the changed people and days.

EngineLabel.title: EngineLabel
EngineLabel.description: Which component produced a value, and whether it is a stand-in.

EscalationOut.title: EscalationOut
EscalationOut.description: W7b: a cover search with ranked options.

FairnessCategory.title: FairnessCategory
FairnessCategory.description: The person's count against anonymous department statistics.

FairnessOut.title: FairnessOut
FairnessOut.description: W8: burden distribution. Names only for the Planner; Oversight gets statistics only.

GapOut.title: GapOut
GapOut.description: A shift the changes leave without a holder.

GapSuggestion.title: GapSuggestion
GapSuggestion.description: Who could fill a gap (Planner only; checked by C2, ranked by C5).

HoursImpact.title: HoursImpact
HoursImpact.description: What taking the shift does to the person's month.

rest_compliance.description: Rest periods in the month as it stands, checked by C2

HoursOut.title: HoursOut
HoursOut.description: M10: contract, planned, worked and overtime hours of a month.

HoursReport.title: HoursReport
HoursReport.description: W8/W12: hours, overtime and rest compliance per person for a month.

Inbox.title: Inbox
Inbox.description: W6: everything waiting for the Planner.

trade_off_check_id.title: Trade Off Check Id
trade_off_check_id.description: Poll GET /me/leave/checks/{id}: C1 checks coverability and a trade-off

LeaveCheck.title: LeaveCheck
LeaveCheck.description: M5: instant hint (C6) and what is known about overlaps.

LeaveImpact.title: LeaveImpact
LeaveImpact.description: What a leave request would mean.

LeaveIn.title: LeaveIn
LeaveIn.description: A leave request. ``with_trade`` needs a finished check that offered a trade-off.

trade_off.title: Trade Off
trade_off.description: The extra weekend duty committed to with 'Mit Tausch beantragen'

LeaveOut.title: LeaveOut
LeaveOut.description: A leave request of the person. The Planner's reason is shown for a decline.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description: Which persona to sign in as.

MasterData.title: MasterData
MasterData.description: W11: shift types, qualifications, contracts, demand templates, rule versions.

MonthRow.title: MonthRow
MonthRow.description: One month with a prepared report.

MyFairness.title: MyFairness
MyFairness.description: M9: nights, weekends and holidays this year.

MyRoster.title: MyRoster
MyRoster.description: M3: the month as published and changed since.

MyWishes.title: MyWishes
MyWishes.description: M4: the open window and the person's answer.

Narrative.title: Narrative
Narrative.description: Explanatory text. Until Phase 10 it is a labelled placeholder, not generated text.

NextShift.title: NextShift
NextShift.description: The next shift and who else works it.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: One notification (the app renders the text from ``kind`` and ``data``).

OfferStep.title: OfferStep
OfferStep.description: One step of a cascade's timeline.

can_take_alone.title: Can Take Alone
can_take_alone.description: Taking it breaks no rule for you (C2)

exchange_options.title: Exchange Options
exchange_options.description: Own shifts you could give in return; valid for both of you (C2)

OpenOffer.title: OpenOffer
OpenOffer.description: An open offer the person could take, alone or as an exchange.

Option.title: Option
Option.description: W7b: one way to close a gap, with its consequence.

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Cost is not modelled in the synthetic data

OversightSummary.title: OversightSummary
OversightSummary.description: W12: read-only view for Klinikleitung, HR and works council.

Overview.title: Overview
Overview.description: W1: what needs the Planner today.

ParsedOut.title: ParsedOut
ParsedOut.description: C7: what was understood. Nothing is saved until the person confirms.

synthetic.title: Synthetic
synthetic.description: True for documents written for this prototype

PendingCascade.title: PendingCascade
PendingCascade.description: A cover search waiting for the Planner.

PendingLeave.title: PendingLeave
PendingLeave.description: A leave request waiting for the Planner.

PendingSwap.title: PendingSwap
PendingSwap.description: A taken swap waiting for the Planner.

PersonEffect.title: PersonEffect
PersonEffect.description: What the changes do to one physician's credited hours.

rest_compliance.description: Rest periods in the month as it stands, checked by C2

PersonHours.title: PersonHours
PersonHours.description: A physician's hours in a month (Planner and Oversight: payroll, working-time records).

PersonMonth.title: PersonMonth
PersonMonth.description: One physician's month (names are resolved here; the stored report holds ids only).

PolicyOut.title: PolicyOut
PolicyOut.description:
What the system approves on its own: only C2-valid swaps and cover inside the department.

Cover by a locum or from another department, and cover that means overtime, always go to
the Planner.

ProposalDecision.title: ProposalDecision
ProposalDecision.description: Accept (to act on it) or dismiss a proposal.

ProposalIn.title: ProposalIn
ProposalIn.description: W9 "Vorschlag erstellen": a proposal for the Planner's inbox.

Published.title: Published
Published.description: W5: the published variant and its approval.

Readiness.title: Readiness
Readiness.description: Readiness response: one entry per backing service.

RecentChange.title: RecentChange
RecentChange.description: A swap or cover settled recently.

Respondent.title: Respondent
Respondent.description: Who received the window and whether they answered.

RestCompliance.title: RestCompliance
RestCompliance.description: Rest periods below the minimum in the month (validator C2).

RosterDay.title: RosterDay
RosterDay.description: One day of the physician's month.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What actually ran: vector, hybrid or fts-only

configured.title: Configured
configured.description: What is configured (RAG_RETRIEVAL); the champion is vector

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: True when the model is missing and full-text ran instead

RuleSearch.title: RuleSearch
RuleSearch.description: Search result. ``found`` is false when no passage supports an answer.

RuleSetIn.title: RuleSetIn
RuleSetIn.description: A new rule version: the full set of rules, effective from a future date.

RunOut.title: RunOut
RunOut.description: A roster run of a month and the versions behind it.

RunsOut.title: RunsOut
RunsOut.description: W3: runs and variants of a month.

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: True if the shift came to this person by a swap or cover

ShiftOut.title: ShiftOut
ShiftOut.description: One shift of the signed-in physician.

SickIn.title: SickIn
SickIn.description: Dates only. There is no field for a diagnosis or a reason.

SickOut.title: SickOut
SickOut.description: M7: the absence and the cover searches started.

Suggestion.title: Suggestion
Suggestion.description: A preference suggestion the person can confirm (C4).

needs_planner.title: Needs Planner
needs_planner.description: Giving the shift away breaks a rule for you (C2), so the Planner decides

SwapAudience.title: SwapAudience
SwapAudience.description: M6: how many colleagues the offer reaches (a count, never names).

exchange.description: An exchange: the shift the taker gave the offerer in return

SwapOut.title: SwapOut
SwapOut.description: A swap the person offered or took.

TakeIn.title: TakeIn
TakeIn.description: Take the shift, optionally giving one of your own shifts in return (an exchange).

Token.title: Token
Token.description: A bearer token for the persona.

TradeOffCheck.title: TradeOffCheck
TradeOffCheck.description:
M5: the background check (C1).

``result.outcome`` is one of coverable, coverable_with_trade_off, not_coverable,
not_applicable (synthdata ASSUMPTIONS §18).

TrailEntry.title: TrailEntry
TrailEntry.description: One entry of the decision trail.

ValidateIn.title: ValidateIn
ValidateIn.description: A month to validate: the published roster as it stands, or a draft variant.

ValidationOut.title: ValidationOut
ValidationOut.description: W4: every violation of the month.

recommendation_key.title: Recommendation Key
recommendation_key.description: i18n key of the reason (deterministic: the balanced profile)

VariantOut.title: VariantOut
VariantOut.description: A variant and what it achieves (metrics from C1, checked by C2).

ViolationOut.title: ViolationOut
ViolationOut.description: A broken rule, as i18n keys with parameters (packages/i18n: violation.*, fix.*).

WhatIfIn.title: WhatIfIn
WhatIfIn.description: Several changes to published rosters, checked together. Nothing is written.

WhatIfOut.title: WhatIfOut
WhatIfOut.description: The effect of a change set, as C2 sees it.

WindowDetail.title: WindowDetail
WindowDetail.description: W2: progress and the list of who has and hasn't answered.

WindowProgress.title: WindowProgress
WindowProgress.description: Progress of the open request window.

WindowTask.title: WindowTask
WindowTask.description: The open request window, if the person has not answered yet.

WishEntry.title: WishEntry
WishEntry.description:
A request-window entry.

``avoid_shift`` is a soft "rather not this shift" on that day: the person stays available for
every other shift, and only the solver's objective sees it.
